player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ HighSociety agorɔ (2-player version) mu.
Agorɔ no fa:  Prestige kaad nnum ne du no wɔ auction mu baako pɛ.
Bid:    Auction biara mu, kɔ pim money kaad 1-11 na fa.
            • Bid kɛse no di prestige kaad no na woyi money kaad no.
            • Bid ketewa no de money kaad no.
            • Tie -> bids mmienu no bɛsan na prestige kaad no wɔ auction mu bio.
Nkontabuo:    Auction nnum ne du no akyi, ka **sika a aka + prestige mma**.
            *Net-worth* kɛse no di (tie pɛ -> draw).

**Action syntax**  →  bid kaad baako sɛ '[7]' anaa '[11]'.

board.money_cards: W'ahyehyɛ sika nkrataa a aka no: {money}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mepɔ wɔ sɛ ɛhwehwe exactly one [X] sika card.

message.tie: Wɔsan de nea wɔabɔ no koro ho ka bae. Ntua!
message.auction_result: P0 bɔ {bid0}, P1 bɔ {bid1}. Player {winner} di prestige {prize} (ɔha {total}).
